chunks: Or has He taken from those He has created daughters for Himself, and assigned sons to you?
ai.seo_question: Why did the polytheists attribute daughters to Allah while preferring sons for themselves?
ai.summary: In the Surah Az-Zukhruf, this verse critiques the pre-Islamic Arab polytheists who attributed daughters to Allah while preferring sons for themselves, highlighting their anthropomorphic projection of gender biases onto the Divine. Shia exegetes, such as Allamah Tabatabai, emphasize this as a logical refutation of their idolatrous beliefs, illustrating how human desires shape theological concepts. The rhetorical question underscores the absurdity of assigning gender and offspring to the transcendent Creator who is beyond such limitations.
